lines.text: There is a season for every purpose under heaven, including a time to be born and a time to die.
There is a time to weep and a time to laugh, and a time to cast away stones.
There is a time to tear and a time to mend, and a time for war and a time for famine.
God has made everything beautiful in its time and has set eternity in the hearts of men.
Nothing is better than to rejoice and do good, and God's work endures forever so that people would trust Him.
